scheme_name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Abandoned Ladies/Destitute
other_conditions: Permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep
Has not remarried after separation or abandonment
No source of income or nominal income not exceeding ₹1,500 per month
Not a beneficiary of any other similar government pension scheme
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 per annum) transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
